name: arlet
description: A Windows-first Apple Music client built with Tauri v2.

scripts.lint: eslint src/ scripts/ && npm run lint:comments
scripts.tauri:dev: npm run sync-version && dotenv -e .env -- tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && tauri build -- --locked
scripts.licenses: npm run licenses:npm && npm run licenses:cargo
scripts.b: git fetch origin && git switch -C beta origin/beta && npm run vi
scripts.r: git fetch origin && git switch -C main origin/main && npm run vi && npm run gitprune:force
scripts.u: node scripts/npm-safe-update.mjs && node scripts/cargo-safe-update.mjs --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/sync-version.js
scripts.u2: node scripts/npm-safe-update.mjs && node scripts/cargo-safe-update.mjs --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/sync-version.js
scripts.build:win:prepared: npm run build:win:x64:prepared && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:win:x64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:win:x64:prepared
scripts.build:win:arm64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:win: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:win:prepared
scripts.rust:update: rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --component cargo,clippy,rustfmt
scripts.rust:targets:win: rustup target add --toolchain stable x86_64-pc-windows-msvc aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.workspace:bootstrap: npm run rust:update && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run sync-version
scripts.workspace:prepare: npm run workspace:bootstrap && npm run test:all -- --require-clean-proof
scripts.release:prepare: npm run workspace:bootstrap && npm run test:all -- --require-clean-proof --skip-e2e && npm run dist:clean-release-artifacts
scripts.prerelease:prepare: node scripts/release-warning.js && dotenv -e .env -- npm run release:preflight && npm run release:licenses
scripts.release:finalize: npm run release:mirror && git fetch origin && git reset --hard @{u} && git clean -fd
scripts.release:win:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:draft && npm run rust:targets:win && npm run build:win:prepared && npm run release:updater-manifests && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize && npm run release:verify:draft
